dedupe_keys.name: on road traffic emission over megacity delhi

description: The National Atmospheric Research Laboratory and collaborating Indian institutions publish estimated road-traffic exhaust emissions for Delhi in 2018. The inventory represents particulate exhaust, black carbon, organic matter, carbon monoxide, nitrogen oxides, volatile organic compounds, ammonia, nitrous oxide and methane. It covers a rectangular domain around the National Capital Territory at 100-metre spatial resolution and hourly time steps. Zenodo provides the NetCDF file free under CC-BY-4.0 through a public deposit. These are estimated emissions, not measured roadside concentrations, and the short repository summary does not state uncertainty bounds or emission-factor assumptions. Those limitations matter when transferring the inventory to another year or evaluating a change in fleet composition. The grids can drive air-quality simulations and transport emission scenarios. They complement road-network and traffic-flow data with pollutant-specific source strengths. No inventory values or model outputs were recalculated.
